channel.title: China Massage Guide
channel.description: Evidence-based guides, articles, and comparisons about Chinese massage, Tui Na, and TCM bodywork.

item.title: Best Chinese Massage Techniques for Back Pain Relief
item.description: Gun Fa (rolling) and An Fa (pressing) along the Bladder Meridian are the most effective Chinese massage techniques for back pain.

item.title: How to Choose the Right Chinese Massage Technique for Your Needs
item.description: Not all Chinese massage techniques serve the same purpose. Learn how to match each method to your specific health goals.

item.title: Is Chinese Massage Painful? What to Expect During Your First Session
item.description: Chinese massage techniques vary in intensity. Learn what sensations are normal, what is not, and how to communicate with your practitioner.

item.title: What Is Chinese Massage? A Beginner's Guide
item.description: New to Chinese massage? This beginner's guide explains what it is, how it differs from Western massage, and what to expect in your first session.

item.title: What Is Deqi Sensation? Understanding the 'Arrival of Qi' in Chinese Massage
item.description: Deqi is the therapeutic sensation that signals acupressure is working. Learn how it feels and why it matters.
